This is errata version PC-E2 of [[Anger, Fear, Aggression (V)]] (version 3 of 3); it is the current text. Each version below is quoted with its dated source, in date order; bracketed names such as [Pilot] stand for icons printed on the cards, ▲ is the icon for “take into hand from Reserve Deck; reshuffle” and ▼ the icon for “deploy from Reserve Deck; reshuffle”.
* '''Original''' ([[Anger, Fear, Aggression (V)]]): Players Committee 2014 Virtual Set 0 release<ref name="eh1351-afa-0">Players Committee, [https://www.scribd.com/document/248869355/Star-Wars-CCG-Virtual-Card-Base-Set Virtual Set 0 Base Set], Light Side Starting Effect (2014 public mirror).</ref>. Dated 2014 (Virtual Set 0); the day of first publication is not known.{{Mystery|question=On what day was this version of Anger, Fear, Aggression (V) first published|section=On what day were the early Virtual Modern card versions first published?}} Text: “Deploy on table with up to 15 cards from outside your deck face-down under here. Four times per game, may play a Defensive Shield from here (as if from hand). Unless canceling your Interrupt, opponent may not play Uncertain Is The Future until the end of your first turn.” No errata mark.
* '''PC-E1''' ([[Anger, Fear, Aggression (V) (Errata)]]): Players Committee “Current Erratas & Unlimited Shields”<ref name="eh1351-afa-1">Players Committee, [https://www.starwarsccg.org/current-erratas-unlimited-shields/ Current Erratas &amp; Unlimited Shields], 16 November 2016, publishes the replacement wording.</ref>. First published 16 November 2016. The Set 0 slip sheet captured 4 July 2017 and the PC card image of 8 July 2018 (Holotable commit 022435b) print this text with an “E” mark. Text: “Deploy on table with any number of Defensive Shields from outside your deck face-down under here. Four times per game, may play a card from here (as if from hand). Unless canceling your Interrupt, opponent may not play Uncertain Is The Future until the end of your first turn.” '''What changed:''' game text: new or changed words “any number of Defensive Shields”, “card”; the printed errata mark is now “E” (was “none”). It prints the errata mark “E”.
* '''PC-E2''' (this page): Players Committee card image<ref name="eh1351-afa-2">Players Committee card image <code>Images-HT/starwars/Virtual0-Light/large/angerfearaggression.gif</code> in the Players Committee's Holotable repository, version of [https://github.com/swccgpc/holotable/commit/ab7441976d996222d5b7235219576492a00bd1e2 commit ab74419] (31 July 2022).</ref>. First published 31 July 2022. The Players Committee announced the remastered Virtual Set 0 images on 1 August 2022. Text: “Deploy on table with any number of Defensive Shields from outside your deck face-down under here. Four times per game, may play a card from here (as if from hand). Unless canceling your Interrupt, opponent may not play Uncertain Is The Future until the end of your first turn.” '''What changed:''' the words are the same: the printed errata mark is now “E1” (was “E”); the margin title lost its uniqueness dot. It prints the errata mark “E1”. This is the current text.
